text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer.
Are you looking something up on your phone?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I'm babysitting a friend's kid for a day soon.
Yeah. I'm looking after a friend's kid for a day soon.

text_block_list.text: Because of that, I was hoping to gift that five-year-old a picture book or take her out somewhere, but...
choice_data_list: I just can't decide on a picture book or a location……

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, if that's the case,
please let me help out too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go together.
To scout the place out—for her!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Mornin'... Whoa! That casual outfit really suits you!
Mornin'... Wow! That casual outfit is so cute!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thank you very much. Truth be told, I was originally planning on coming in my usual clothes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle gave me advice, saying,
"Since it's a special occasion, you should dress
in something autumn-themed~."
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's the perfect outfit for autumn!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aha. If hearing you say that is my reward,
Trainer, then it was totally worth wearing this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That kid reads a lot of books, right? I wonder if she's read famous picture books, then...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Happy Prince," huh? I love it, but maybe something more obscure—like "The Water of Life"?
Though she might already know Grimm's Fairy Tales...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's look for a new release. That way,
she's sure to encounter a picture book she's never seen beforeâ

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This is by my favorite author!
It's already out...? I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Swan's Errand’... Hehe, looks interesting.
Though, it might be a bit too easy for a five-year-old—"
After having K.S.Miracle pick out two picture books, we leave the bookstore. Both the insightful fairy tale and the fun educational book were wonderful choices.
choice_data_list: Thanks for helping me!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about that.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry about this.
Buying one for me too, I mean.
choice_data_list: Because your eyes were sparkling! I just had to give it to you!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha.
You saw an embarrassing side of me, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "This park isn't very crowded even on weekends, so I think it's a great place to relax."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "We could read the picture book I gave her together here... and there are swan boats too, so that might be nice if she wants to be more active."
choice_data_list: Huh, a swan boat! That sounds fun!
Huh, a swan boat! That sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once we've rested a bit,
shall we go take a look over there as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
Isn't it about time I took a turn rowing?"
choice_data_list: It's fine! Leave today to me! Uooooh!
It's fine! Leave today to me! Uooooh!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You are so kind.
However――
choice_data_list: Whoa...? W-Wait, you've got so much momentum... Miracle!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
See?
I told you I was faster, didn't I? Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa... That swan boat was so much fun.
I guess I got a little too excited.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Where shall we head next? This park has lovely
flower beds too! Shall we go take a peek there as well?
choice_data_list: Ah, nice! I bet she'll love it!
Yeah, sounds great! I'm sure she'll love it!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That girl...—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list: ...? What's the matter?
...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“......I'm sorry, Trainer.
I...”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For a moment... I completely forgot we were just scouting.
I was just having so much fun...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so unfair.

K.S. Miracle looked thoroughly embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red.
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: You're having fun— what's wrong with that?
What's wrong with you having fun?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.
choice_data_list: When you're having fun, it's okay to just say "I'm having fun," you know.

text_block_list.text:
Having fun while scouting isn't a bad thing at all.
Looking into her eyes, I told her there was no need to blame herself, and continued—
choice_data_list: Well then, where should we go next?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
............
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, um... just the flowerbed.
Could I take one last, proper look at it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want her to have fun, too.
Her, as well."

K.S. Miracle looked thoroughly embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red.
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: Then maybe I am too!
Then maybe I am too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
You too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: There were times I completely forgot to preview the course too!
Because there were times when I forgot to scout ahead too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“......Ahaha.
I see—”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I'm so glad to hear you say that. Hehe..."

K.S. Miracle looked thoroughly embarrassed, her cheeks flushed red.
Seeing her like that—
choice_data_list: It's not unfair at all. Not even a bit.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

"If anything, I'd rather she be even more selfish.
In her case, that would probably be just right."
choice_data_list: Want to go take a look at the flower bed?
